exposure: Women with grade III placenta (premature placental calcification)
cohort: 293 pregnant women who presented to three academic medical centres from September 2011 to March 2013
finding: Passive smoking was the only predictor of early placental calcification, and women with premature placental calcification had more abnormal Doppler findings, low birth weight babies, and caesarean section deliveries.
mod_finding: Caesarean section deliveries were more common in the preterm placental calcification group.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was more common in the preterm placental calcification group.
